policy: All active benchmark works must have spoken audio or multimodal symbolic narrative structure and documented Public Domain or Creative Commons / archival research provenance. Silent stock clips (e.g. 268230_medium.mp4) are deprecated for narrative metrics.

works.title: Debate Universitario sobre Insumisión y Servicio Militar (España, c. 1994)
works.description: Five university students and one activist poster debating compulsory military service ('la mili'), conscientious objection, and civil disobedience ('insumisión'). High stance entropy and competing legal vs. abolitionist frames.

works.title: 'Peace, Little Girl' (The 'Daisy' Commercial) — LBJ Presidential Campaign (1964)
works.license: Public Domain (U.S. Pre-1978 Broadcast without Copyright Renewal / Library of Congress & NARA)
works.description: Pioneering 60-second political spot by Doyle Dane Bernbach & Tony Schwartz juxtaposing a child counting daisy petals with a missile launch countdown and nuclear detonation.

works.title: President Ronald Reagan's Address to the Nation on the Explosion of the Space Shuttle Challenger (1986)
works.license: Public Domain (17 U.S.C. § 105 Work of the U.S. Federal Government / NARA / Reagan Library)
works.description: Oval Office presidential address transforming national shock and grief over the Challenger disaster into collective mourning, heroic mythmaking, and institutional continuity.
